metadataRaw.title: Standing Piriformis Release for Instant Sciatica Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates the step-back exercise, which helps release tight glutes and piriformis muscles, a common cause of sciatica symptoms in the buttocks and legs. It's especially effective for sciatica caused by deep gluteal syndrome and piriformis syndrome.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may provide sciatica relief in as little as 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
